_note: The project is called Little Souls. Everything a user sees takes its names from this file, so the product can be renamed per market without touching code. 'daemon' is the internal word in code and docs only.

poem.latin: Animula vagula blandula, hospes comesque corporis…
poem.en: Little soul, wandering, gentle, guest and companion of the body…
poem.author: Emperor Hadrian
